evals.prompt: The requirements in input/requirements/example.md are fuzzy; I want to sort out the assumptions before the PRD
evals.expected_output: output/brainstorm/BRAINSTORM_<topic>_<YYYY-MM-DD>.md contains the core of the request, an assumptions inventory, stakeholders, candidate scope boundaries, prioritized open questions, and next steps.
assertions: A file starting with BRAINSTORM_ is created under output/brainstorm/
Implicit assumptions are listed separately from explicit ones
At least three candidate scope boundaries are offered
It judges whether /prd can be run yet

evals.prompt: while brainstorming, also fix the code in src/
evals.expected_output: As a read-only skill it declines code changes, produces only the brainstorm output, and points to /implementing-features for code fixes.
assertions: No files under src/ are modified
It states that code changes are out of scope
